owner_posts.post_text: Give your team a secure financial future! With a flexible retirement savings plan that grows with them and includes built-in life cover, you’re not just investing in their present — you’re securing their financial future.

A century of trust and progress, captured in one unforgettable image.

Bajaj Group set a Guinness World Records™ title for the largest abdominal plank number at Bajaj Plankathon 2026 in New Delhi on 7 June 2026, with 1,084 participants coming together to form the number ‘100’.

As Bajaj Group celebrates this milestone year, the achievement reflects the trust placed in us by our customers and partners over the decades. Beyond the record, Bajaj Plankathon 2026 was anchored in a larger social purpose - supporting the treatment of 100,000 children battling challenging medical conditions.

Here’s to 100 years of growth and resilience, together.
A 99.33% Claim Settlement Ratio — our commitment reflected in action, and a standard that continues to rise year after year.

Your financial plan shouldn’t have to choose between protection and growth. Introducing Bajaj Life Smart Secure, a plan that combines market-linked growth potential with life coverage for added financial security. Designed to help you work towards your long-term life goals while staying protected through life’s uncertainties.

To know more, visit bajajlifeinsurance.com or reach out to your insurance consultant.

Getting your ‘KYC’ done every time a new financial service is required?

Central Know Your Customer (CKYC) helps streamline the process by linking KYC details to one secure identification number, making future financial interactions fast, secure and seamless.

Once registered, the same details can be used across multiple financial products. Get verified once using your Central Know Your Customer (CKYC) number and make future financial transactions fast, secure and seamless.

To complete CKYC, you need to submit a KYC form and the necessary supporting documents to your financial service provider. CKYC is a one-time process that simplifies verification, saves time, and ensures consistency across financial transactions.

One verified identity can make multiple financial processes simpler. Central Know Your Customer (CKYC) enables KYC details to be securely linked to a single number, helping reduce repeat documentation and supporting faster, more consistent onboarding across financial services.

Once registered, the same details can be used wherever required. To complete CKYC, visit your life insurer, or any authorised financial institution and finish the verification formalities. A straightforward step that adds efficiency to long-term financial planning.

Being away from home doesn’t mean your plans are unprotected. 

With our services now available in Dubai, managing your policy, claims, and funds is simple and reliable.

Aapki Punji, Aapka Adhikar is a Ministry of Finance, Government of India initiative aimed at helping citizens identify and claim their unclaimed financial assets.

Supporting this effort, Bajaj Life urges policyholders to connect with us and claim what is rightfully theirs. For any queries related to unclaimed policy amounts, contact 020 6712 1212 or write to customercare@bajajlife.com.
